title: The top-level update-manifest.json reads stale on a real install
description: Spun out of MPI-709 (2026-09-08), not blocking the 1.5.0 re-cut. resources/cubric/update-manifest.json on a real install read 1.3.0 while that install was running 1.5.0 - stale by two updates. MPI-709's delta guard is NOT exposed to it (it reads the installed version from the app's own package.json, deliberately, because this manifest was measured stale). Unknown: who else reads it and whether any reader is load-bearing. The trap: MPI-523's unit test for this manifest PASSES, so the staleness is not something the test can see - ask why a green test and a stale file coexist before editing the test. Detail: brief.md.
